'''Lameril Ridge''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ridge on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. [[Pekaelic ke Teldan]], once a [[perator]] of [[Cartann]], won a great battle there and thus earned the title [[Hero of Lameril Ridge]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
